E. Pacific Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 500 AM PDT Sat Oct 17 2026
South of Southern Mexico:
An area of low pressure is forecast to form offshore of southern Mexico during the early to middle part of next week. Environmental conditions appear conducive for gradual development thereafter, and a tropical depression is likely to form during the latter half of next week while it moves generally westward to west-northwestward over the eastern and central portions of the East Pacific.
